scope.coverage_limit: Selected domain-specific semantic mutations across all 48 identified backend areas. This is not an exhaustive enumeration of every possible source mutation.
scope.caught_meaning: The ten CAUGHT controls are independent audit checks rather than pytest assertion kills.

source_and_evidence.environment_limit: Source and oracle bytes were frozen. Worker virtual environments and node_modules used existing local dependencies; dependency directories were linked rather than frozen into a hermetic image.
source_and_evidence.documentary_drift_after_snapshot: Report artifacts were refreshed after the runs. Publication added exact-value secret-scanner exceptions in .gitleaks.toml; production, mutation targets, behavioral oracle source, catalogs, runner, replay helper, and canonical triage remain at their frozen bytes.

historical_Y7.reason: A legitimate Spanish-majority diary includes 48 English observations with grammatical porque code-switching and 72 Spanish entries. Real language detection and full brain.update show pottery as a valid topic. Removing the original window guard additionally surfaces porque as a false topic.
historical_Y7.resolution: Restored the original source replacement and added the missing full-result behavioral oracle. It passes unchanged source and kills the original definition in the fresh final historical replay. The exploratory per-entry replacement remains recorded as earlier evidence and supplies no substitute credit.

deadline_boundary_O01.resolution: An initial equivalence interpretation was overturned. The original boundary mutation was retained as O01-06 and KILLED by a valid already-buffered ASGI receive oracle; O01-05 separately tests disabling the total deadline.

survivor_triage.policy: Original exploratory outcomes and overturned classifications remain recorded. Both challenged original mutations were retained and killed by behavioral oracles; no original survivor is replaced or ignored in the final counts.

fixes.behavior: Reject non-string signed token purposes as TokenError instead of raising TypeError.
Reject supplied non-list feedback channels as malformed input instead of silently discarding them.

Serialize clinical note operations against retirement and erasure, release fresh read transactions before lock waits, bound history reads, preserve durable audit evidence, and verify snapshot consistency.
Use per-entry language for theme decontamination and topic eligibility; remove theme-driven lexical bias from rolling and weekday baselines; consistently handle nonfinite explicit mood ratings.
Describe multiday sleep/tag associations with truthful lag wording.
Preserve fragmented crisis expressions containing leading pronouns and split grammar while retaining all previously caught normalization cases.
Provide isolated baseline-gated mutation execution with process cleanup, exact source restoration, raw-log hashes and CI execution tests.

postgresql_skips: Dedicated O05 destructive migration URL intentionally unset; exercised separately by mutation campaign
validation.skip_policy: Skipped tests were not credited as mutant kills.

reproduction.working_directory: Repository root unless a command says backend. Use the project backend virtual environment and project dependency setup.
reproduction.postgresql_setup: docker run -d --name fathom-deep-mutation-pg -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust -e POSTGRES_DB=mindpattern_mutation_test -p 127.0.0.1:55488:5432 postgres:16-alpine
reproduction.postgresql_readiness: Wait for pg_isready before running the operations catalog. Use this disposable database because the migration oracle resets its schema.
reproduction.selector_replay_requirement: The optimized replay uses the retained previous final run to select previously failing cases only when the exact source mutation is unchanged. Previous Y7 used a per-entry mutation, so its differing identity causes the restored original Y7 to retain its whole expanded current oracle. Every command is freshly baseline-gated and executed; no kill credit is reused.
reproduction.postgresql_full_suite_from_backend: Unset DEEP_MUTATION_POSTGRES_URL; set MINDPATTERN_TEST_DB_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres@127.0.0.1:55488/mindpattern_final_test and run .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ from backend.
reproduction.output_requirement: Choose a fresh output directory for each mutation run.
reproduction.postgresql_oracle_environment: The operations catalog sets DEEP_MUTATION_POSTGRES_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://postgres@127.0.0.1:55488/mindpattern_mutation_test on its migration oracle commands. No global export is needed for the all48 runner.
reproduction.postgresql_full_suite_database_setup: docker exec fathom-deep-mutation-pg createdb -U postgres mindpattern_final_test

artifacts.archive_mapping: For a log path in either results/baselines file, its basename maps to logs/<basename> in the corresponding run archive. Original absolute local log paths are retained without rewriting the evidence.
